ei.title: Carol Williams' Quiz Night Donation Request
ei.subject: 2022 고2 11월 모의고사

fullPassage: Dear local business owners, My name is Carol Williams, president of the student council at Yellowstone High School. We are hosting our annual quiz night on March 30 and plan to give prizes to the winning team. However, this event won't be possible without the support of local businesses who provide valuable products and services. Would you be willing to donate a gift certificate that we can use as a prize? We would be grateful for any amount on the certificate. In exchange for your generosity, we would place an advertisement for your business on our answer sheets. Thank you for taking time to read this letter and consider our request. If you'd like to donate or need more information, please call or email me. I look forward to hearing from you soon.

If you'd like to ③<u>donate</u> or need more information, please call or ④<u>email</u> me. I look forward to hearing from you soon.

❌ ① canceling(취소하다): hosting 반의어
❌ ② losing(패배하는): winning 반의어
✅ ③ hosting — winning — generosity: 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ hostility(적대감): generosity 반의어
det.tip: hosting(개최), winning(우승), generosity(관대함)

questions.passage: Dear local business owners, My name is Carol Williams, president of the __________ at Yellowstone High School. We are hosting our annual quiz night on March 30 and plan to give prizes to the winning team. However, this event won't be possible without the support of local businesses who provide valuable products and services. Would you be willing to donate a gift certificate that we can use as a prize? We would be grateful for any amount on the certificate. In exchange for your generosity, we would place an advertisement for your business on our answer sheets. Thank you for taking time to read this letter and consider our request. If you'd like to donate or need more information, please call or email me. I look forward to hearing from you soon.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① student council: 원문 일치. 학생회 회장이 쓴 편지 ←정답
❌ ② teaching staff(교직원): 학생이 쓴 편지이므로 부적절
❌ ③ alumni association(동문회): 재학생이므로 동문회 부적절
❌ ④ board of directors(이사회): 학생 조직이므로 부적절
det.tip: student council(학생회): 학생이 운영하는 자치 조직
